source.author: Laleh Bakhtiar
source.edition: Kazi Publications 2007; her account in a Beliefnet interview, July 2007

summary.en: While translating, she doubted the usual reading because she held that the Prophet ﷺ never hit anyone. She found "to go away" among the meanings of ḍaraba in Edward Lane's 1863 Arabic-English Lexicon, and saw it as matching his conduct: when he was upset with his wives, he went away from them. Her translation renders the word "go away."
